title: Adjust the clutch cable
summary: Set clutch lever free play on a manual bike so gears engage cleanly and the clutch doesn't slip.
tools: Box wrenches for the lock nuts

steps.text: With the engine off, pull the clutch lever gently until you feel resistance. Measure the gap at the lever tip; most bikes want 10 to 20 mm.
For small changes, loosen the lock ring at the lever and turn the barrel adjuster. Turn it out to reduce free play, in to add it.
If the barrel runs out of thread, set it back to the middle and make the larger change with the adjuster at the engine end.
Tighten both lock nuts and recheck the free play.
Start the engine, pull the clutch and select first gear. The bike should not creep, and should not slip when you accelerate in a high gear.
steps.caution: Zero free play keeps the clutch partly disengaged and wears it out fast. Always leave some play.
